decisions.explanation: These are runtime VPI errors: a zero-delay cbReadWriteSynch registered during read-only synchronization, a zero-delay cbAtStartOfSimTime after a time slice has begun, and a suppressed or NULL time structure for a time callback. No SystemVerilog design is illegal, so the error kind cannot use :should_fail_because:. Icarus Verilog 13.0 does not report every case and Verilator has no vpi_control, so a clean NULL return and vpi_chk_error result is not observable.
decisions.reviewer: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (AI); not an independent human review

decisions.explanation: The existing test observes the cbReadOnlySynch callback after nonblocking assignments, but the clause's prohibition on writing values or scheduling events before the next scheduled event has no defined result when violated. The test does not write in the callback, and a violation cannot be turned into a fixed expected output.
